logic: What a receipt drawn from its frozen data prints (plan v3 slice 1.9): one case per case of receipts/v1/frozen.json, chained by name, so the frozen receipt of the case of the same name is the input; input.v2Sample names the v2 receipt the expected text comes from (regression/v2/receipts/<sample>.json). The expected value is v2's printed text with the listed difference of D11 and nothing else: body is the text of every page in reading order without the footer line and, on a yearly receipt, without the column headers of the gift table, each line as v2 extracted it (U+00A0 as a space), the lines joined by one space, every run of white space one space, and every Czech date d. M. yyyy written dd. MM. yyyy (15. 03. 2026, plan v3 D11; English dates stay 15 March 2026); tableHeader is the column headers of the gift table as page 1 prints them, joined the same way (null for a single receipt), which a yearly receipt repeats at the top of every page its table runs onto; footer is the footer line every page carries, without the page number (n / m) v2 prints after it; v2Pages is the page count of the v2 receipt. The browser (receipt-layout.spec.ts) draws the frozen receipt of the same name and reads its PDF with pdf.js: the text of every page outside the page artifacts, with the column headers and the verification caption taken out, must give body word for word; every page carries the footer and its page number as a pagination artifact; a yearly receipt prints the column headers once per page of its table; the PDF has at most v2Pages + 1 pages. The backend (donations/infrastructure/pdf/FrozenReceiptCasesTest) derives the expected value from the v2 sample again and fails when the file says anything else, so the file cannot drift from what v2 printed; it goes with that class in 1.10.
